title: refactor(metadata-protocol): getMetaTypes() declares a named return type, pinned equal to the type it returned
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8RqNbmRd8gSUxXNtggBEwUr)_
Fixes #29510

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`getMetaTypes()` 现在声明具名返回类型 `Promise<MetaTypesListing>`,由 spec 已导出的类型组合而成;方法体内一行编译期 `Equal` 断言把它钉成与方法体推断出的类型完全相等。
- 为什么改:原来是推断类型,`index.d.ts` 内联展开 793 行,#25467 每一刀都要人工读这一块原始 diff。现在 d.ts 只印别名,类型一旦漂移 `tsc` 直接报错。
- 风险与回滚:无运行时改动,公开类型不变(已对 main 构建出的 d.ts 做过一次类型相等证明);`MetaTypesListing` 不从包导出,不新增公开名。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-types-listing.ts`(类型定义,注意 `actions` 的两臂);`protocol.ts` 中 `getMetaTypes()` 的签名与结尾 `exact` 一行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`,预期 exit 0;把类型里 `schemaId: string;` 改成 `schemaId?: string;` 再跑,预期只在 `exact` 那一行报 TS2322。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-types-listing.ts` (new, 68 lines): `MetaTypesListingEntry`, `MetaTypesListing` and a strict `Equal` type. The entry is `MetadataTypeRegistryEntryParsed` (minus `type`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, `actions`) plus the fields the listing adds or overrides: `type: string`, `schemaId`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay: boolean`, `overrideSource`, `schema: Record<string, unknown>`, `form: FormView`, `createSeed?: {} | null`, and `actions?: Action[] | NonNullable<MetadataTypeRegistryEntryParsed['actions']>`. The second `actions` arm is in main's type because the row spreads the registry entry before it overrides `actions`; leaving it out fails the pin. A mapped `Flatten` turns the intersection into one object type, which the strict `Equal` needs to compare equal to an inferred object literal. Nothing new is exported from the package index.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: `getMetaTypes()` declares `Promise<MetaTypesListing>`. The body is unchanged up to its last line, which now builds `const listing = { types: allTypes, entries }`, holds `const exact: Equal<typeof listing, MetaTypesListing> = true`, and returns `listing`. One type-only import. 11 lines, +9/-2.
- `.changeset/29510-meta-types-named-return.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, both declaration lines.

## Why

The #25467 E1 seat ruling (PR #29488) kept `getMetaTypes()` inferred so E1's `index.d.ts` stayed byte-identical, and moved the explicit return type to its own step, option B of the E1 report: a named composed type with a type-equality pin. Triage audit 6592554479 kept it p3, `domain:server`.

### What retires the per-cut raw-diff reading of `getMetaTypes()`

The `exact` line. `typeof listing` is the type the body infers, which is the type `main` emitted. If a cut or any later edit changes what the body builds, or changes the declared name, `tsc` fails at that line in `typecheck` and in the tsup declaration build. The `.d.ts` now prints `getMetaTypes(): Promise<MetaTypesListing>` and an alias, so there is no 793-line inline block left for a cut to read, and no inferred block a stray class comment can surface inside.

What this does not retire: ruling 6348891160's whole-`index.d.ts` reading still applies to each cut, because other public members of the class stay inferred (`getDiscovery`, `getMetaItems`, `getMetaItem`, `findData`, … as listed in 6385903828). The module comment above the `protocol-meta-type-schema.js` import in `protocol.ts` ("read its raw diff after any edit here") is still true for them, so it is left as it is.

## Tests

Measured on `main` 1c1a5d40 before the edit: the dependency closure built under the lock (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/metadata-protocol...' build`, VERDICT command-exit 0). `dist/index.d.ts` lines 3057–3849 hold `getMetaTypes()`: 793 lines, sha256 `b0f7f61a…c85bf`, starting `getMetaTypes(): Promise<{` and ending `}>;`. No comment sits inside that block on this tree.

<details><summary>Type equality against main's emitted type (one-time proof, not committed)</summary>

A scratch probe beside the package imported `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` from a copy of main's `dist/index.d.ts` and from this branch's rebuilt `dist/index.d.ts`, and compiled `Equal<Before, After>` and `Equal<Before['entries'][number], After['entries'][number]>` with `true`: `tsc` exit 0. Negative control, same probe plus `Equal<Before['entries'][number], Omit<After['entries'][number], 'schemaId'>> = true`: exit 2, `TS2322: Type 'true' is not assignable to type 'false'`. The probe was deleted afterwards.

The `.d.ts` text diff, main vs this branch: the 793-line block becomes `getMetaTypes(): Promise<MetaTypesListing>;`, 39 lines of alias declarations are added (not exported), and two import lines change (`FormFieldInput` was only used inside the old inline block; `FormView`, `Action` and `MetadataTypeRegistryEntryParsed` are now imported). Nothing else in the file moves.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the pin fails on a member drift</summary>

Committed first (65252421), then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file …/protocol-meta-types-listing.ts --anchor "schemaId: string;" --replacement "schemaId?: string;" -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`, with an `EXIT INT TERM` trap restoring from `HEAD`:

- mutation landed: anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `81483bc18bca` → `b5392c1a893c`;
- `tsc --noEmit`: one error, `src/protocol.ts(3297,15): error TS2322: Type 'true' is not assignable to type 'false'` (the `exact` line), exit 2;
- restored: blob == HEAD (`81483bc18bca`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

Making a member optional is assignable to the declared type, so `return` alone would not catch it. Only the pin did.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates on 94b9d02b3 (final head, after merging main c9636f1e5)</summary>

- Builds under the lock: `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/metadata-protocol... --filter=@objectstack/objectql` (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` under the lock: Test Files 308 passed, 4 skipped (312); Tests 22264 passed, 26 skipped (22290); VERDICT command-exit 0. (On 65252421, before the merge: 22262 passed, VERDICT 0.)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0 (the pin holds on the merged tree).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 54 families (3 paths vs merge base, +87/-2), the same list before and after the merge. Each run once, exit captured before any pipe: 53 exit 0.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (about 70 workspace packages unbuilt in this container). NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it on a full build.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 54 derived, 53 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (dual-build, from its recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN.
- Prerequisites met on the first round: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched (shallow clone), `check:lean-entry-closure` needed objectql built; both then exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `.d.ts` text changes and the type does not; that is the card's stated bar, measured above.
- `MetaTypesListing` and `MetaTypesListingEntry` are not exported from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, so no new public name.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 section is the repo's required Chinese brief)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
